name: University of Southern California
character: The predominantly red-brick campus features mostly Romanesque Revival buildings contrasted by Modernist structures, including two large Brutalist dormitories at its northern edge.

landmarks.name: Widney Alumni House
landmarks.quote: Widney Alumni House, built in 1880, is the oldest university building in Southern California.

landmarks.name: Old College
landmarks.quote: USC was further expanded with the construction of Old College in 1887, which served as the college of Liberal Arts
